<!-- FAQ Section -->
<div class="section section-gray">
<div class="container">

<h2 class="section-title">Frequently <span>Asked</span></h2>

<div class="grid-2">

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Is there a free plan?</h3>
<p>Yes. The Free plan gives you 3 projects, 1 team member and the programme module with 1 programme. Upgrade any time as your needs grow.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Is the programme module included in every plan?</h3>
<p>Yes. Every plan includes the programme module with Gantt, critical path, baselines and MS Project or Asta import. The plan sets how many programmes, baselines and imports you get: Free includes 1 programme, Essential 10, and Professional and Scale unlimited programmes of up to 2,000 tasks each.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What is Agent Access?</h3>
<p>Agent Access connects your own AI agent (Claude, Cursor or Codex) to the Praevius MCP server with OAuth sign-in. Read access is available on every plan, including Free. Write tools need Professional or Scale, and every write needs your confirmation. You can revoke access at any time under Settings → Security → Connected agents.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>How does the free trial work?</h3>
<p>Essential and Professional start with a 30-day free trial, and no credit card is needed. Scale starts through our sales team. If the trial ends without payment, your account falls back to the Free plan limits. Nothing is deleted.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Are there any per-user fees?</h3>
<p>No. Each plan includes a set number of team members, and the Scale plan includes unlimited team members. No hidden per-seat charges.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>Can I change plans later?</h3>
<p>Yes. Change your plan anytime from the Billing page. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, and you can reactivate it before that date.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What about annual billing?</h3>
<p>Pay annually and save 17%. Annual prices are $821.70 for Essential, $1,900.70 for Professional and $3,726.70 for Scale.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What integrations are included?</h3>
<p>Essential includes Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync and one accounting integration: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online or Sage Intacct. Professional and Scale include all three accounting integrations. Scale adds Procore ↔ SharePoint Sync and Schedule of Values.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>What's included in support?</h3>
<p>Every plan includes email support at support@praevius.app.</p>
</div>

<div class="feature-card">
<h3>How does Praevius compare to Procore?</h3>
<p>Praevius is built specifically for subcontractors and QS professionals, with simpler pricing and no per-user fees. While Procore targets general contractors with enterprise features, Praevius delivers professional-grade cost control at mid-market pricing starting at $99/month.</p>
</div>

</div>

</div>
